activity.titleZh: 行李没有出现在转盘上

transcript.speaker: Traveler
transcript.text: Excuse me, my suitcase didn't arrive on carousel six.
transcript.translationZh: 打扰一下，我的行李箱没有出现在六号转盘上。

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry. May I see your baggage tag and boarding pass?
transcript.translationZh: 很抱歉。可以看一下您的行李牌和登机牌吗？

transcript.speaker: Traveler
transcript.text: Here they are. I arrived on flight 482 from Seattle.
transcript.translationZh: 给您。我乘坐从西雅图来的 482 航班抵达。

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you describe the suitcase?
transcript.translationZh: 您可以描述一下行李箱吗？

transcript.speaker: Traveler
transcript.text: It's a medium black suitcase with a red tag.
transcript.translationZh: 是一个中等大小的黑色行李箱，带红色标签。

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I found the record. The bag is on the next flight and should arrive at nine.
transcript.translationZh: 我找到记录了。行李在下一班航班上，应该九点到。

transcript.speaker: Traveler
transcript.text: Could you send it to my hotel?
transcript.translationZh: 你们可以把它送到我的酒店吗？

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes. Please write the hotel name and address here.
transcript.translationZh: 可以。请在这里写下酒店名称和地址。

checks.rationaleZh: 旅客说 carousel six。

options: 中号黑色箱子，红色标签
大号黑色箱子，蓝色标签

activity.titleZh: 在博物馆请求工作人员协助

transcript.speaker: Visitor
transcript.text: Excuse me, I need help. My friend feels dizzy.
transcript.translationZh: 打扰一下，我需要帮助。我的朋友头晕。

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: Is your friend awake and able to sit down?
transcript.translationZh: 你的朋友清醒并且可以坐下吗？

transcript.speaker: Visitor
transcript.text: Yes. We're by the north entrance, next to the information desk.
transcript.translationZh: 可以。我们在北门，问讯台旁边。

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: Stay there. I'll bring our first-aid staff.
transcript.translationZh: 待在那里。我会带急救人员过去。

transcript.speaker: Visitor
transcript.text: Thank you. Do you need my phone number?
transcript.translationZh: 谢谢。你需要我的电话号码吗？

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: Not yet. If the situation becomes an emergency, call local emergency services immediately.
transcript.translationZh: 暂时不需要。如果情况变成紧急状况，请立即联系当地紧急服务。

checks.rationaleZh: 访客说 friend feels dizzy。
by the north entrance, next to the information desk。
工作人员说 bring our first-aid staff。

transcript.speaker: Traveler
transcript.text: Excuse me, where is the hotel shuttle pickup?
transcript.translationZh: 打扰一下，酒店接驳车上车点在哪里？

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: Outside door seven. The River Hotel shuttle comes every thirty minutes.
transcript.translationZh: 在七号门外。River Hotel 接驳车每三十分钟一班。

transcript.speaker: Traveler
transcript.text: Is there a fare?
transcript.translationZh: 需要车费吗？

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: No, it's free for hotel guests.
transcript.translationZh: 不需要，对酒店住客免费。

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: At the hotel, Min checks in under the name Zhou and receives room 624.
transcript.translationZh: 到酒店后，Min 用 Zhou 的姓名入住，拿到 624 房。

transcript.speaker: Traveler
transcript.text: Is breakfast included, and what time is checkout?
transcript.translationZh: 早餐包含吗？几点退房？

transcript.speaker: Clerk
transcript.text: Breakfast is included. Checkout is at eleven.
transcript.translationZh: 早餐包含。十一点退房。

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: In the room, Min discovers that the Wi-Fi does not connect and calls the front desk.
transcript.translationZh: 进入房间后，Min 发现 Wi-Fi 连不上，于是打电话给前台。

transcript.speaker: Traveler
transcript.text: Hi, this is room 624. I can't connect to the Wi-Fi.
transcript.translationZh: 你好，这里是 624 房。我连不上 Wi-Fi。

checks.rationaleZh: 工作人员说 Outside door seven。
酒店住客免费。
Min 说 can't connect to the Wi-Fi。

transcript.speaker: Friend
transcript.text: The museum is across from Central Park, but the Green Line is closed today.
transcript.translationZh: 博物馆在中央公园对面，但绿线今天停运。

transcript.speaker: Traveler
transcript.text: Could we take the number twelve bus instead?
transcript.translationZh: 我们可以改坐 12 路公交吗？

transcript.speaker: Friend
transcript.text: Yes. Get off at the fourth stop and walk one block east.
transcript.translationZh: 可以。在第四站下车，然后向东走一个街区。

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: After the museum, they choose a nearby restaurant.
transcript.translationZh: 参观博物馆后，他们选择附近一家餐厅。

transcript.speaker: Traveler
transcript.text: I'd like the chicken salad without cheese. I'm allergic to peanuts.
transcript.translationZh: 我想要鸡肉沙拉，不加奶酪。我对花生过敏。

transcript.speaker: Server
transcript.text: The dressing has peanuts, so I'll bring a different one.
transcript.translationZh: 这款沙拉酱含花生，所以我会换一种。

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Later, the traveler returns shoes that are too small.
transcript.translationZh: 之后，旅客退换一双太小的鞋。

transcript.speaker: Traveler
transcript.text: I have the receipt. Could I exchange these for a size nine?
transcript.translationZh: 我有收据。可以换成九码吗？

transcript.speaker: Clerk
transcript.text: Yes. We have size nine in black, and the price is the same.
transcript.translationZh: 可以。黑色有九码，价格一样。

items.exampleEn: The website promised flexibility when I paid the higher fare.
items.exampleZh: 我支付较高票价时，网站承诺可以灵活变更。

items.term: Because the entry stamp is unclear, could you record where and when I arrived?
items.meaningZh: 由于入境章不清楚，您能记录我的入境地点和时间吗？
items.exampleEn: Because the entry stamp is unclear, could you record where and when I arrived?
items.exampleZh: 由于入境章不清楚，您能记录我的入境地点和时间吗？

items.term: My statement shows the charge under an unfamiliar company name.
items.meaningZh: 我的账单显示这笔扣款来自一个陌生的公司名称。
items.exampleEn: My statement shows the charge under an unfamiliar company name.
items.exampleZh: 我的账单显示这笔扣款来自一个陌生的公司名称。

items.term: I am asking for reconsideration based on circumstances outside my control.
items.meaningZh: 我请求你们根据这些不可控情况重新考虑。
items.exampleEn: I am asking for reconsideration based on circumstances outside my control.
items.exampleZh: 我请求你们根据这些不可控情况重新考虑。

items.term: Keep every replacement confirmation together so the additional expenses remain easy to trace.
items.meaningZh: 请把所有替代安排确认放在一起，以便清楚追溯额外费用。
items.exampleEn: Keep every replacement confirmation together so the additional expenses remain easy to trace.
items.exampleZh: 请把所有替代安排确认放在一起，以便清楚追溯额外费用。

items.term: Unless the printed authorization is accepted, I may miss the only permitted connection.
items.meaningZh: 除非打印的授权书被接受，否则我可能错过唯一允许的转机。
items.exampleEn: Unless the printed authorization is accepted, I may miss the only permitted connection.
items.exampleZh: 除非打印的授权书被接受，否则我可能错过唯一允许的转机。

items.term: Could the missed-night value offset the upgrade required at the replacement property?
items.meaningZh: 损失的一晚费用能否抵扣替代住宿所需的升级费用？
items.exampleEn: Could the missed-night value offset the upgrade required at the replacement property?
items.exampleZh: 损失的一晚费用能否抵扣替代住宿所需的升级费用？

items.term: The voucher covered part of the cost, according to this confirmation.
items.meaningZh: 根据这份确认，代金券抵扣了部分费用。
items.exampleEn: The voucher covered part of the cost, according to this confirmation.
items.exampleZh: 根据这份确认，代金券抵扣了部分费用。

items.term: Would a digital residence permit work if the border system cannot retrieve my profile?
items.meaningZh: 如果边境系统无法调取我的资料，电子居留许可还能使用吗？
items.exampleEn: Would a digital residence permit work if the border system cannot retrieve my profile?
items.exampleZh: 如果边境系统无法调取我的资料，电子居留许可还能使用吗？

items.term: The terminal charged me twice, although only one payment was approved.
items.meaningZh: 终端向我扣款两次，但我只批准了一笔付款。
items.exampleEn: The terminal charged me twice, although only one payment was approved.
items.exampleZh: 终端向我扣款两次，但我只批准了一笔付款。

items.term: The transaction date predates my arrival, which raises another concern.
items.meaningZh: 交易日期早于我的抵达时间，这又引出了一个疑问。
items.exampleEn: The transaction date predates my arrival, which raises another concern.
items.exampleZh: 交易日期早于我的抵达时间，这又引出了一个疑问。

items.term: Once the claim is corrected, how will reimbursement reach me while I remain abroad?
items.meaningZh: 理赔信息更正后，我仍在国外时将如何收到报销款？
items.exampleEn: Once the claim is corrected, how will reimbursement reach me while I remain abroad?
items.exampleZh: 理赔信息更正后，我仍在国外时将如何收到报销款？

items.term: I submitted everything requested, but the appeal was closed without explanation.
items.meaningZh: 我提交了所有要求的材料，但申诉却被无解释地关闭了。
items.exampleEn: I submitted everything requested, but the appeal was closed without explanation.
items.exampleZh: 我提交了所有要求的材料，但申诉却被无解释地关闭了。

items.term: Could the penalty be reduced rather than applying the maximum charge?
items.meaningZh: 能否降低罚金，而不是收取最高金额？
items.exampleEn: Could the penalty be reduced rather than applying the maximum charge?
items.exampleZh: 能否降低罚金，而不是收取最高金额？

items.term: The deposit was charged separately but never deducted from the final balance.
items.meaningZh: 押金被单独收取，却没有从最终余额中扣除。
items.exampleEn: The deposit was charged separately but never deducted from the final balance.
items.exampleZh: 押金被单独收取，却没有从最终余额中扣除。

items.term: The patient can travel seated only if monitoring equipment remains powered throughout every transfer.
items.meaningZh: 只有在每段转运中监测设备持续供电，患者才能坐姿旅行。
items.exampleEn: The patient can travel seated only if monitoring equipment remains powered throughout every transfer.
items.exampleZh: 只有在每段转运中监测设备持续供电，患者才能坐姿旅行。

items.term: What evidence supports moving me ahead of the planned procedure?
items.meaningZh: 哪些证据支持在原定治疗前将我转移？
items.exampleEn: What evidence supports moving me ahead of the planned procedure?
items.exampleZh: 哪些证据支持在原定治疗前将我转移？

items.term: My family needs one update channel because international calls are failing during the evacuation.
items.meaningZh: 撤离期间国际电话无法接通，我的家人需要一个统一的信息渠道。
items.exampleEn: My family needs one update channel because international calls are failing during the evacuation.
items.exampleZh: 撤离期间国际电话无法接通，我的家人需要一个统一的信息渠道。

items.term: The hospital cannot discharge me until suitable care is confirmed at my destination.
items.meaningZh: 在目的地确认有合适的后续照护前，医院不能让我出院。
items.exampleEn: The hospital cannot discharge me until suitable care is confirmed at my destination.
items.exampleZh: 在目的地确认有合适的后续照护前，医院不能让我出院。

items.term: After the journey, who will consolidate receipts, service failures, and promised corrections into one outcome?
items.meaningZh: 旅程结束后，谁会把收据、服务失败和承诺更正汇总成一个处理结果？
items.exampleEn: After the journey, who will consolidate receipts, service failures, and promised corrections into one outcome?
items.exampleZh: 旅程结束后，谁会把收据、服务失败和承诺更正汇总成一个处理结果？

items.term: Before I pay again, please identify who can authorize reimbursement for this replacement service.
items.meaningZh: 在我再次付款前，请说明谁能批准这项替代服务的报销。
items.exampleEn: Before I pay again, please identify who can authorize reimbursement for this replacement service.
items.exampleZh: 在我再次付款前，请说明谁能批准这项替代服务的报销。

items.term: Although assistance was approved, no party has confirmed who will meet us after landing.
items.meaningZh: 虽然援助已获批准，但还没有任何一方确认落地后由谁接我们。
items.exampleEn: Although assistance was approved, no party has confirmed who will meet us after landing.
items.exampleZh: 虽然援助已获批准，但还没有任何一方确认落地后由谁接我们。

items.term: What combination of records creates the clearest sequence from disruption to additional expense?
items.meaningZh: 哪些记录组合最清楚地展示从行程中断到额外支出的过程？
items.exampleEn: What combination of records creates the clearest sequence from disruption to additional expense?
items.exampleZh: 哪些记录组合最清楚地展示从行程中断到额外支出的过程？

items.term: The hotel blamed late arrival, while the flight record shows we reached the desk before closure.
items.meaningZh: 酒店归因于迟到，但航班记录显示我们在前台关闭前已经到达。
items.exampleEn: The hotel blamed late arrival, while the flight record shows we reached the desk before closure.
items.exampleZh: 酒店归因于迟到，但航班记录显示我们在前台关闭前已经到达。

items.term: Please compare air evacuation with ground transfer, including clinical risk, clearance time, and backup options.
items.meaningZh: 请比较空中撤离与地面转运，包括临床风险、通关时间和备用方案。
items.exampleEn: Please compare air evacuation with ground transfer, including clinical risk, clearance time, and backup options.
items.exampleZh: 请比较空中撤离与地面转运，包括临床风险、通关时间和备用方案。

items.term: Would the conclusion change if the transfer time is measured from landing rather than gate arrival?
items.meaningZh: 如果转乘时间从落地而非到达登机口开始计算，结论会改变吗？
items.exampleEn: Would the conclusion change if the transfer time is measured from landing rather than gate arrival?
items.exampleZh: 如果转乘时间从落地而非到达登机口开始计算，结论会改变吗？

items.term: My screenshots show changing prices; which timestamp should define the reasonable replacement cost?
items.meaningZh: 我的截图显示价格不断变化，哪个时间点应界定合理的替代成本？
items.exampleEn: My screenshots show changing prices; which timestamp should define the reasonable replacement cost?
items.exampleZh: 我的截图显示价格不断变化，哪个时间点应界定合理的替代成本？

items.term: Can the hotel and platform agree which company should issue the revised invoice?
items.meaningZh: 酒店和平台能否确认应由哪家公司开具修改后的发票？
items.exampleEn: Can the hotel and platform agree which company should issue the revised invoice?
items.exampleZh: 酒店和平台能否确认应由哪家公司开具修改后的发票？

items.term: Which provider should arrange immediate transport while the refund responsibility is still being determined?
items.meaningZh: 在退款责任尚未确定时，哪家服务商应先安排即时交通？
items.exampleEn: Which provider should arrange immediate transport while the refund responsibility is still being determined?
items.exampleZh: 在退款责任尚未确定时，哪家服务商应先安排即时交通？

items.term: Who will combine these records into one explanation I can verify?
items.meaningZh: 由谁把这些记录整合成一份我能够核实的说明？
items.exampleEn: Who will combine these records into one explanation I can verify?
items.exampleZh: 由谁把这些记录整合成一份我能够核实的说明？

items.term: Please merge the evidence without losing either case's communication history.
items.meaningZh: 请合并证据，同时不要丢失任一案件的沟通记录。
items.exampleEn: Please merge the evidence without losing either case's communication history.
items.exampleZh: 请合并证据，同时不要丢失任一案件的沟通记录。

items.term: Because the route crosses two jurisdictions, medication documentation must satisfy both inspection points.
items.meaningZh: 由于路线跨越两个管辖区，药品文件必须同时满足两个检查点的要求。
items.exampleEn: Because the route crosses two jurisdictions, medication documentation must satisfy both inspection points.
items.exampleZh: 由于路线跨越两个管辖区，药品文件必须同时满足两个检查点的要求。

items.term: The insurer approved evacuation to one country, whereas my visa only permits entry elsewhere.
items.meaningZh: 保险批准撤离到一个国家，但我的签证只允许进入另一个国家。
items.exampleEn: The insurer approved evacuation to one country, whereas my visa only permits entry elsewhere.
items.exampleZh: 保险批准撤离到一个国家，但我的签证只允许进入另一个国家。

items.term: Who can verify receipt of sensitive documents without exposing their contents?
items.meaningZh: 谁能在不泄露内容的情况下确认敏感文件已经收到？
items.exampleEn: Who can verify receipt of sensitive documents without exposing their contents?
items.exampleZh: 谁能在不泄露内容的情况下确认敏感文件已经收到？

items.term: If the planned crossing becomes inaccessible, who has authority to activate the secondary route?
items.meaningZh: 如果计划口岸无法通行，谁有权启动备用路线？
items.exampleEn: If the planned crossing becomes inaccessible, who has authority to activate the secondary route?
items.exampleZh: 如果计划口岸无法通行，谁有权启动备用路线？

items.term: If that deadline is missed, what escalation path remains available?
items.meaningZh: 如果错过该期限，还有什么升级处理途径？
items.exampleEn: If that deadline is missed, what escalation path remains available?
items.exampleZh: 如果错过该期限，还有什么升级处理途径？

items.term: Set a decision threshold for waiting, rebooking, relocating, and requesting external assistance.
items.meaningZh: 请为等待、改订、搬迁和请求外部协助设定决策门槛。
items.exampleEn: Set a decision threshold for waiting, rebooking, relocating, and requesting external assistance.
items.exampleZh: 请为等待、改订、搬迁和请求外部协助设定决策门槛。

items.term: Could every provider confirm its completed action, remaining task, and next response time in one message?
items.meaningZh: 能否请每家服务商在一条信息中确认已完成事项、剩余任务和下次回复时间？
items.exampleEn: Could every provider confirm its completed action, remaining task, and next response time in one message?
items.exampleZh: 能否请每家服务商在一条信息中确认已完成事项、剩余任务和下次回复时间？

items.term: The tour operator promised collection, yet the local driver received neither my name nor revised schedule.
items.meaningZh: 旅行运营商承诺接送，但当地司机既没收到我的姓名，也没收到修改后的时间表。
items.exampleEn: The tour operator promised collection, yet the local driver received neither my name nor revised schedule.
items.exampleZh: 旅行运营商承诺接送，但当地司机既没收到我的姓名，也没收到修改后的时间表。

items.term: Please establish decision times for departure, border clearance, admission, and the fallback transfer.
items.meaningZh: 请确定出发、边境通关、入院和备用转运的决策时间点。
items.exampleEn: Please establish decision times for departure, border clearance, admission, and the fallback transfer.
items.exampleZh: 请确定出发、边境通关、入院和备用转运的决策时间点。

items.term: The interpreter should remain available through consent, handover, and the first assessment after arrival.
items.meaningZh: 口译员应在知情同意、交接和抵达后的首次评估全程保持可用。
items.exampleEn: The interpreter should remain available through consent, handover, and the first assessment after arrival.
items.exampleZh: 口译员应在知情同意、交接和抵达后的首次评估全程保持可用。

items.term: Can we choose a safer route without losing the approved assistance?
items.meaningZh: 我们能否选择更安全的路线，同时保留已批准的协助？
items.exampleEn: Can we choose a safer route without losing the approved assistance?
items.exampleZh: 我们能否选择更安全的路线，同时保留已批准的协助？

items.term: My family needs one contact who can explain changes to the arrangements.
items.meaningZh: 我的家人需要一位能够解释安排变化的联系人。
items.exampleEn: My family needs one contact who can explain changes to the arrangements.
items.exampleZh: 我的家人需要一位能够解释安排变化的联系人。

items.term: Rather than collect more documents, determine which missing fact would materially change the decision.
items.meaningZh: 与其继续收集文件，不如确定哪个缺失事实会实质改变决定。
items.exampleEn: Rather than collect more documents, determine which missing fact would materially change the decision.
items.exampleZh: 与其继续收集文件，不如确定哪个缺失事实会实质改变决定。

items.term: Three companies handled this payment, so which one is tracing the missing funds?
items.meaningZh: 这笔付款经过三家公司处理，究竟由哪一家追查未到账资金？
items.exampleEn: Three companies handled this payment, so which one is tracing the missing funds?
items.exampleZh: 这笔付款经过三家公司处理，究竟由哪一家追查未到账资金？

items.term: Which supporting document shows how the retained amount was determined?
items.meaningZh: 哪份支持文件说明了保留金额是如何确定的？
items.exampleEn: Which supporting document shows how the retained amount was determined?
items.exampleZh: 哪份支持文件说明了保留金额是如何确定的？

items.term: The evacuation provider needs recent test results before confirming whether cabin travel remains safe.
items.meaningZh: 撤离服务商需要最新检查结果，才能确认机舱运输是否仍然安全。
items.exampleEn: The evacuation provider needs recent test results before confirming whether cabin travel remains safe.
items.exampleZh: 撤离服务商需要最新检查结果，才能确认机舱运输是否仍然安全。

items.term: Which team will verify completion rather than simply forwarding my request to another department?
items.meaningZh: 哪个团队会核实处理完成，而不是只把我的请求转给另一个部门？
items.exampleEn: Which team will verify completion rather than simply forwarding my request to another department?
items.exampleZh: 哪个团队会核实处理完成，而不是只把我的请求转给另一个部门？

items.term: Which emergency contact can align the consulate, insurer, airline, and receiving clinic before departure?
items.meaningZh: 哪位紧急联系人能在出发前协调领事馆、保险方、航空公司和接收诊所？
items.exampleEn: Which emergency contact can align the consulate, insurer, airline, and receiving clinic before departure?
items.exampleZh: 哪位紧急联系人能在出发前协调领事馆、保险方、航空公司和接收诊所？

items.term: My condition is stable now, but the journey includes a lengthy connection.
items.meaningZh: 我的病情目前稳定，但行程包含一次长时间转机。
items.exampleEn: My condition is stable now, but the journey includes a lengthy connection.
items.exampleZh: 我的病情目前稳定，但行程包含一次长时间转机。

items.term: Compare the insurer's approval with the clinic estimate to expose any uncovered service before treatment.
items.meaningZh: 请比较保险批准内容与诊所估价，以便在治疗前发现未覆盖服务。
items.exampleEn: Compare the insurer's approval with the clinic estimate to expose any uncovered service before treatment.
items.exampleZh: 请比较保险批准内容与诊所估价，以便在治疗前发现未覆盖服务。

items.term: The airline approved oxygen, but the ground transfer has not been confirmed.
items.meaningZh: 航空公司批准了供氧，但地面转运尚未确认。
items.exampleEn: The airline approved oxygen, but the ground transfer has not been confirmed.
items.exampleZh: 航空公司批准了供氧，但地面转运尚未确认。

items.term: If weather cancels the flight, where will monitored care continue until another route opens?
items.meaningZh: 如果天气导致航班取消，在另一条路线开放前，监护治疗将在哪里继续？
items.exampleEn: If weather cancels the flight, where will monitored care continue until another route opens?
items.exampleZh: 如果天气导致航班取消，在另一条路线开放前，监护治疗将在哪里继续？

items.term: Could the connection be shortened even if the alternative flight costs more?
items.meaningZh: 即使替代航班费用更高，能否缩短转机时间？
items.exampleEn: Could the connection be shortened even if the alternative flight costs more?
items.exampleZh: 即使替代航班费用更高，能否缩短转机时间？

items.term: If my companion cannot cross, who will carry the consent documents and personal medication?
items.meaningZh: 如果我的同行人无法过境，谁来携带同意文件和个人药物？
items.exampleEn: If my companion cannot cross, who will carry the consent documents and personal medication?
items.exampleZh: 如果我的同行人无法过境，谁来携带同意文件和个人药物？

items.term: A named doctor must confirm my fitness prior to any repatriation arrangements.
items.meaningZh: 安排医疗送返前，由谁确认我的身体状况适合旅行？
items.exampleEn: A named doctor must confirm my fitness prior to any repatriation arrangements.
items.exampleZh: 安排医疗送返前，由谁确认我的身体状况适合旅行？

items.term: Please explain which unresolved issue blocks the final arrangement and who can remove that obstacle.
items.meaningZh: 请说明哪个未解决问题阻碍最终安排，以及谁能排除该障碍。
items.exampleEn: Please explain which unresolved issue blocks the final arrangement and who can remove that obstacle.
items.exampleZh: 请说明哪个未解决问题阻碍最终安排，以及谁能排除该障碍。

items.term: My home insurer and local provider disagree about which stabilization procedures must happen first.
items.meaningZh: 本国保险方和当地服务商对哪些稳定措施必须先进行意见不一。
items.exampleEn: My home insurer and local provider disagree about which stabilization procedures must happen first.
items.exampleZh: 本国保险方和当地服务商对哪些稳定措施必须先进行意见不一。

items.term: The call summary conflicts with the written message; please identify which instruction was actually followed.
items.meaningZh: 通话摘要与书面信息冲突，请确认实际执行的是哪项指示。
items.exampleEn: The call summary conflicts with the written message; please identify which instruction was actually followed.
items.exampleZh: 通话摘要与书面信息冲突，请确认实际执行的是哪项指示。

items.term: The tax amount changed after checkout, although the service itself did not.
items.meaningZh: 结账后税额发生了变化，但服务本身没有变化。
items.exampleEn: The tax amount changed after checkout, although the service itself did not.
items.exampleZh: 结账后税额发生了变化，但服务本身没有变化。

items.term: Would delaying departure improve medical stability without causing the entry authorization to expire?
items.meaningZh: 推迟出发能否提高医疗稳定性，同时避免入境授权过期？
items.exampleEn: Would delaying departure improve medical stability without causing the entry authorization to expire?
items.exampleZh: 推迟出发能否提高医疗稳定性，同时避免入境授权过期？

items.term: Please ensure my records reach the receiving doctor before I arrive.
items.meaningZh: 请确保我的病历在我抵达前送达接诊医生。
items.exampleEn: Please ensure my records reach the receiving doctor before I arrive.
items.exampleZh: 请确保我的病历在我抵达前送达接诊医生。

items.term: The hotel offered one night, provided the airline arranges transport and the agent extends our booking.
items.meaningZh: 酒店愿意提供一晚，前提是航空公司安排交通且代理延长我们的预订。
items.exampleEn: The hotel offered one night, provided the airline arranges transport and the agent extends our booking.

transcript.text: The noon shuttle was canceled. The next one leaves at one thirty.

transcript.text: At the airport, Ana notices that her passport is missing.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please contact the hotel now and report the missing passport at the information desk.
transcript.translationZh: 请立即联系酒店，并在问讯台报告护照丢失。

transcript.text: The hotel finds the passport and sends it with a driver.

lessons.titleZh: 结课任务：完整旅行日与关键求助
observableObjectives: 听完综合旅行脚本后识别主旨、顺序和至少三个关键细节。
在固定角色任务中完成确认、替代、纠错和求助。
区分“已能独立完成”“需要提示”和“尚未掌握”的场景意图。

activity.instructionsZh: 按沟通意图检索语言，不再背孤立列表。

items.term: Who will maintain temperature records while my medicine passes through customs and airport security?
items.meaningZh: 我的药物经过海关和机场安检时，谁负责持续记录温度？
items.exampleEn: Who will maintain temperature records while my medicine passes through customs and airport security?
items.exampleZh: 我的药物经过海关和机场安检时，谁负责持续记录温度？

items.term: The platform closed my case before the acquiring bank responded.
items.meaningZh: 收单银行尚未回复，平台就关闭了我的案件。
items.exampleEn: The platform closed my case before the acquiring bank responded.
items.exampleZh: 收单银行尚未回复，平台就关闭了我的案件。

items.term: Could border staff review the passenger list early so the medical convoy avoids unnecessary waiting?
items.meaningZh: 边境人员能否提前审核乘客名单，让医疗车队避免不必要的等待？
items.exampleEn: Could border staff review the passenger list early so the medical convoy avoids unnecessary waiting?
items.exampleZh: 边境人员能否提前审核乘客名单，让医疗车队避免不必要的等待？

items.term: Would an air ambulance be safer than a commercial flight with assistance?
items.meaningZh: 与提供协助的商业航班相比，医疗专机是否更安全？
items.exampleEn: Would an air ambulance be safer than a commercial flight with assistance?
items.exampleZh: 与提供协助的商业航班相比，医疗专机是否更安全？

items.term: I need the adjustment linked to the original charge, not recorded separately.
items.meaningZh: 我需要将调整关联至原始扣款，而不是另行记录。
items.exampleEn: I need the adjustment linked to the original charge, not recorded separately.
items.exampleZh: 我需要将调整关联至原始扣款，而不是另行记录。

items.term: What calculation explains the difference between the quoted and collected totals?
items.meaningZh: 什么计算方式能够解释报价总额与实收总额的差异？
items.exampleEn: What calculation explains the difference between the quoted and collected totals?
items.exampleZh: 什么计算方式能够解释报价总额与实收总额的差异？

items.term: Can the baggage handler share its delivery estimate with both the hotel and transport provider?
items.meaningZh: 行李处理方能否同时向酒店和交通服务商分享预计送达时间？
items.exampleEn: Can the baggage handler share its delivery estimate with both the hotel and transport provider?
items.exampleZh: 行李处理方能否同时向酒店和交通服务商分享预计送达时间？

items.term: Please compare the proposed routes against my mobility limit, budget ceiling, and required arrival time.
items.meaningZh: 请根据我的行动限制、预算上限和必须到达时间比较建议路线。
items.exampleEn: Please compare the proposed routes against my mobility limit, budget ceiling, and required arrival time.
items.exampleZh: 请根据我的行动限制、预算上限和必须到达时间比较建议路线。

items.term: The cheaper solution has three uncertain dependencies, while the expensive one has a confirmed departure.
items.meaningZh: 较便宜的方案有三个不确定依赖，而较贵的方案已有确认出发时间。
items.exampleEn: The cheaper solution has three uncertain dependencies, while the expensive one has a confirmed departure.
items.exampleZh: 较便宜的方案有三个不确定依赖，而较贵的方案已有确认出发时间。

items.term: My temporary passport permits travel, although the destination still requires proof of urgent treatment.
items.meaningZh: 我的临时护照允许旅行，但目的地仍要求提供紧急治疗证明。
items.exampleEn: My temporary passport permits travel, although the destination still requires proof of urgent treatment.
items.exampleZh: 我的临时护照允许旅行，但目的地仍要求提供紧急治疗证明。

items.term: The translated summary omits an allergy that could affect emergency treatment.
items.meaningZh: 翻译后的病情摘要遗漏了一项可能影响急救的过敏信息。
items.exampleEn: The translated summary omits an allergy that could affect emergency treatment.
items.exampleZh: 翻译后的病情摘要遗漏了一项可能影响急救的过敏信息。

items.term: One option minimizes cost, another reduces risk, and the third preserves future flexibility.
items.meaningZh: 一个方案成本最低，另一个风险更小，第三个保留未来灵活性。
items.exampleEn: One option minimizes cost, another reduces risk, and the third preserves future flexibility.
items.exampleZh: 一个方案成本最低，另一个风险更小，第三个保留未来灵活性。

items.term: Before selecting a plan, separate confirmed constraints from assumptions that still require verification.
items.meaningZh: 选择方案前，请把已确认的限制和仍需核实的假设分开。
items.exampleEn: Before selecting a plan, separate confirmed constraints from assumptions that still require verification.
items.exampleZh: 选择方案前，请把已确认的限制和仍需核实的假设分开。

items.term: The receipt was reissued, but it still lists the wrong billing currency.
items.meaningZh: 收据已经重新开具，但仍列出了错误的结算货币。
items.exampleEn: The receipt was reissued, but it still lists the wrong billing currency.
items.exampleZh: 收据已经重新开具，但仍列出了错误的结算货币。

items.term: Please identify the party verifying the airline's ability to meet those medical requirements.
items.meaningZh: 由谁核实航空公司能够满足这些医疗要求？
items.exampleEn: Please identify the party verifying the airline's ability to meet those medical requirements.
items.exampleZh: 由谁核实航空公司能够满足这些医疗要求？

items.term: My bags followed the original flight, whereas I was moved through a different airport.
items.meaningZh: 我的行李仍走原航班，而我被改经另一个机场。
items.exampleEn: My bags followed the original flight, whereas I was moved through a different airport.
items.exampleZh: 我的行李仍走原航班，而我被改经另一个机场。

items.term: The transfer plan needs a backup facility in case admission is refused.
items.meaningZh: 转运方案需要准备一家备用机构，以防接收入院被拒。

items.exampleZh: 转运方案需要准备一家备用机构，以防接收入院被拒。

items.term: Before departure, assign responsibility for tickets, documents, accommodation, medication, and family updates.
items.meaningZh: 出发前，请分别指定机票、文件、住宿、药物和家人通知的负责人。
items.exampleEn: Before departure, assign responsibility for tickets, documents, accommodation, medication, and family updates.
items.exampleZh: 出发前，请分别指定机票、文件、住宿、药物和家人通知的负责人。

items.term: Who will synchronize the account once the financial adjustment is complete?
items.meaningZh: 财务调整完成后，由谁同步更新账户？
items.exampleEn: Who will synchronize the account once the financial adjustment is complete?
items.exampleZh: 财务调整完成后，由谁同步更新账户？

items.term: How will my medication remain refrigerated throughout the entire journey?
items.meaningZh: 整个旅程中，我的药物将如何持续冷藏？

items.exampleZh: 整个旅程中，我的药物将如何持续冷藏？

items.term: Which authority can correct the destination error without restarting every emergency arrangement?
items.meaningZh: 哪个机构可以更正目的地错误，而不必重新启动所有紧急安排？
items.exampleEn: Which authority can correct the destination error without restarting every emergency arrangement?
items.exampleZh: 哪个机构可以更正目的地错误，而不必重新启动所有紧急安排？

items.term: Would delaying departure by one day reduce the risk of complications?
items.meaningZh: 把出发时间推迟一天，是否能降低并发症风险？
items.exampleEn: Would delaying departure by one day reduce the risk of complications?
items.exampleZh: 把出发时间推迟一天，是否能降低并发症风险？

items.term: The carrier approved meals, while the airport contractor rejected the same authorization code.
items.meaningZh: 承运方批准了餐食，但机场承包商拒绝了同一个授权码。
items.exampleEn: The carrier approved meals, while the airport contractor rejected the same authorization code.
items.exampleZh: 承运方批准了餐食，但机场承包商拒绝了同一个授权码。

items.term: Could the airline and cruise operator agree whether this revised arrival still protects my boarding?
items.meaningZh: 航空公司和邮轮运营方能否确认修改后的到达时间是否仍能保障登船？
items.exampleEn: Could the airline and cruise operator agree whether this revised arrival still protects my boarding?
items.exampleZh: 航空公司和邮轮运营方能否确认修改后的到达时间是否仍能保障登船？

items.term: Could you convert these findings into assigned actions with deadlines, owners, and fallback triggers?
items.meaningZh: 您能把这些发现转化为带截止时间、负责人和备用触发条件的任务吗？
items.exampleEn: Could you convert these findings into assigned actions with deadlines, owners, and fallback triggers?
items.exampleZh: 您能把这些发现转化为带截止时间、负责人和备用触发条件的任务吗？

items.term: Please name the provider responsible for my care during the international transfer.
items.meaningZh: 国际转运期间，哪家机构继续负责我的医疗照护？
items.exampleEn: Please name the provider responsible for my care during the international transfer.
items.exampleZh: 国际转运期间，哪家机构继续负责我的医疗照护？

items.term: The local operator completed the service, although the international platform has not released payment.
items.meaningZh: 当地运营方已经完成服务，但国际平台尚未放款。
items.exampleEn: The local operator completed the service, although the international platform has not released payment.
items.exampleZh: 当地运营方已经完成服务，但国际平台尚未放款。

items.term: The provider's explanation fits the records, except for one unexplained hour before cancellation.
items.meaningZh: 服务商的解释与记录基本吻合，但取消前有一小时无法解释。
items.exampleEn: The provider's explanation fits the records, except for one unexplained hour before cancellation.
items.exampleZh: 服务商的解释与记录基本吻合，但取消前有一小时无法解释。

items.term: How will those resulting costs be considered in the proposed remedy?
items.meaningZh: 建议的补救方案将如何考虑这些后续产生的费用？
items.exampleEn: How will those resulting costs be considered in the proposed remedy?
items.exampleZh: 建议的补救方案将如何考虑这些后续产生的费用？

items.term: Before moving me, confirm that medication, mobility support, and translated records will travel simultaneously.
items.meaningZh: 转移我之前，请确认药物、行动协助和翻译病历会同时随行。
items.exampleEn: Before moving me, confirm that medication, mobility support, and translated records will travel simultaneously.
items.exampleZh: 转移我之前，请确认药物、行动协助和翻译病历会同时随行。

items.term: The rail company accepts the delay evidence, but the airline disputes when the connection became impossible.
items.meaningZh: 铁路公司接受延误证明，但航空公司对何时已无法转乘存在异议。
items.exampleEn: The rail company accepts the delay evidence, but the airline disputes when the connection became impossible.
items.exampleZh: 铁路公司接受延误证明，但航空公司对何时已无法转乘存在异议。

items.term: The bank confirms settlement, while the booking platform still shows payment pending.
items.meaningZh: 银行确认已经结算，但预订平台仍显示付款处理中。
items.exampleEn: The bank confirms settlement, while the booking platform still shows payment pending.
items.exampleZh: 银行确认已经结算，但预订平台仍显示付款处理中。

items.term: The transfer vendor needs passenger details that the booking platform says it cannot disclose.
items.meaningZh: 接送供应商需要乘客资料，但预订平台称不能披露。
items.exampleEn: The transfer vendor needs passenger details that the booking platform says it cannot disclose.
items.exampleZh: 接送供应商需要乘客资料，但预订平台称不能披露。

items.term: The booking email and payment record agree, but the provider's timeline shows a later cancellation.
items.meaningZh: 预订邮件和付款记录一致，但服务商时间线显示取消发生得更晚。
items.exampleEn: The booking email and payment record agree, but the provider's timeline shows a later cancellation.
items.exampleZh: 预订邮件和付款记录一致，但服务商时间线显示取消发生得更晚。

items.term: Can the receiving clinic confirm it has the equipment my treatment requires?
items.meaningZh: 接收诊所能否确认具备我治疗所需的设备？

items.exampleZh: 接收诊所能否确认具备我治疗所需的设备？

items.term: If the border closes overnight, what medically safe alternative keeps the care plan uninterrupted?
items.meaningZh: 如果边境夜间关闭，什么医学上安全的替代方案能保证治疗不中断？
items.exampleEn: If the border closes overnight, what medically safe alternative keeps the care plan uninterrupted?
items.exampleZh: 如果边境夜间关闭，什么医学上安全的替代方案能保证治疗不中断？

items.exampleZh: 获批后我的病情发生变化，现有运输方案是否仍符合当前医疗需求？

items.meaningZh: 在供应商信息一致前，我的雇主无法报销这次出行。
items.exampleEn: My employer cannot reimburse the trip until the supplier details match.
items.exampleZh: 在供应商信息一致前，我的雇主无法报销这次出行。

items.term: I want a clear handover between the overseas hospital and my home doctor.
items.meaningZh: 我希望海外医院与我的本地医生之间进行清晰交接。
items.exampleEn: I want a clear handover between the overseas hospital and my home doctor.
items.exampleZh: 我希望海外医院与我的本地医生之间进行清晰交接。

items.term: My account shows two case numbers for what appears to be one dispute.
items.meaningZh: 我的账户针对同一笔争议似乎显示了两个案件编号。

items.exampleZh: 我的账户针对同一笔争议似乎显示了两个案件编号。

items.term: The strongest evidence proves timing, but weaker records better explain the resulting inconvenience.

items.exampleEn: The strongest evidence proves timing, but weaker records better explain the resulting inconvenience.
items.exampleZh: 最有力的证据证明了时间，而较弱的记录更能解释由此造成的不便。

items.term: Which receipts demonstrate unavoidable spending, and which merely reflect a more convenient choice?
items.meaningZh: 哪些收据证明支出不可避免，哪些只是反映了更方便的选择？

items.exampleZh: 哪些收据证明支出不可避免，哪些只是反映了更方便的选择？

activity.titleZh: 一个有变更的完整旅行日

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Sam checks out of room 407 at eleven and asks the front desk to store one suitcase until two.
transcript.translationZh: Sam 十一点从 407 房退房，请前台保管一个行李箱到两点。

transcript.speaker: Traveler
transcript.text: Could you recommend a nearby lunch place before I leave?
transcript.translationZh: 离开前，你可以推荐附近吃午饭的地方吗？

transcript.speaker: Clerk
transcript.text: Try Pine Café across from the library. Take bus six for three stops.
transcript.translationZh: 试试图书馆对面的 Pine Café。坐 6 路公交三站。

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: At the café, Sam orders a turkey sandwich without cheese and tells the server about a peanut allergy.
transcript.translationZh: 在咖啡店，Sam 点了不加奶酪的火鸡三明治，并告诉服务员自己对花生过敏。

transcript.speaker: Server
transcript.text: The bread is safe, but the cookie contains peanuts. Would you like fruit instead?
transcript.translationZh: 面包没问题，但饼干含花生。要改成水果吗？

transcript.speaker: Traveler
transcript.text: Yes, fruit instead, please. And could I get the check by one thirty?
transcript.translationZh: 好的，请改成水果。我可以在一点半前拿到账单吗？

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Back at the hotel, Sam picks up the suitcase and takes a taxi to the airport.
transcript.translationZh: 回到酒店后，Sam 取了行李箱，坐出租车去机场。

transcript.speaker: Driver
transcript.text: Traffic is heavy. The usual entrance is closed, so I'll use terminal two drop-off.
transcript.translationZh: 交通拥堵。常用入口关闭了，所以我会使用二号航站楼下客区。

transcript.speaker: Traveler
transcript.text: That's fine. My flight leaves at five forty.
transcript.translationZh: 可以。我的航班五点四十起飞。

transcript.speaker: Announcement
transcript.text: Flight 905 to Phoenix will board at gate B16 instead of B12. Boarding begins at five.
transcript.translationZh: 飞往菲尼克斯的 905 航班将在 B16 而不是 B12 登机。五点开始登机。

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: At the gate, another traveler feels dizzy. Sam tells the gate agent the person is awake and sitting near B16.
transcript.translationZh: 在登机口，另一名旅客头晕。Sam 告诉登机口工作人员，此人清醒，坐在 B16 附近。

transcript.speaker: Traveler
transcript.text: We need help near gate B16. The traveler feels dizzy but is awake.
transcript.translationZh: 我们在 B16 登机口附近需要帮助。这名旅客头晕，但人清醒。

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Stay with the traveler. Medical staff are on the way.
transcript.translationZh: 请陪着这名旅客。医疗人员正在赶来。
